verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas documents that founders can create, send, and track SAFEs from the Dashboard, and that it provides Cooley-developed legal document templates. That is a narrow, controlled document workflow for one contract type, not email attachments, but there is no evidence of general contract drafting, negotiation, or redlining. missing for 10: negotiation workflow, redlining/version comparison, drafting of arbitrary contract types, approval controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can draft, negotiate, and redline contracts in a controlled workflow instead of email attachments

citations.quote: creating, sending, and tracking Simple Agreements for Future Equity (SAFEs) from your Dashboard
access to legal documents developed with Cooley (a law firm for startups)
